title: </sub>  Provide repository-scoped webhook enablement
text:
</sub>  Provide repository-scoped webhook enablement

When one webhook process reviews multiple repositories, the declared sources cannot independently enable the sweep for one repository and disable it for another: `runWebhookReviewJob` calls the process-global `loadConfig()` (`src/webhook/webhook-job.ts:218-220`), whose environment and operator file contain one value for every job, while workflow inputs exist only on the Actions ingress. Either define a repository-keyed webhook configuration source or narrow this requirement to deployment-wide enablement; otherwise AC18 is not implementable for a normal multi-repository webhook installation.
